name: TX-16
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Veronica Escobar running with a large fundraising edge
No polls or expert ratings; challenger underfunded and little known
Prediction markets price Democratic win near certainty
model.rationale: Escobar is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic by double digits, while Bauman has shown no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets price her win at roughly 97%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race or a surge of outside spending for Bauman would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Veronica Escobar seeks another term in this El Paso-based district, which leans Democratic by about eleven points and gave Democrats a comfortable margin in recent cycles. She has raised roughly $860,000 and holds cash on hand, while Republican Adam Bauman reports no significant fundraising or outside backing.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which price Escobar near certain to win. The forecast calls for a Democratic margin of about twenty-one points, with a Safe D rating and moderate confidence given the absence of direct polling.
